messages.text:
I’ll build a Python port focused on the requested xsv subcommands and make the evaluator entrypoint unambiguous on Windows.

The finish line is byte-matching CLI behavior; to get there safely I need to inspect the Rust command surfaces and the reference binary path once, then implement the smallest compatible Python command set.
